<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Geopolitical and Energy Headwinds:</strong> Global markets are under pressure from the Russia-Ukraine war and US-Iran conflict, which have pushed Brent crude above $106 and contributed to a sharp tightening of domestic liquidity.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>FII Outflow Drivers:</strong> The ongoing exodus of foreign capital from Indian equities is being exacerbated by rising US bond yields and a weakening rupee, creating a challenging environment for domestic asset valuations.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a></span></li>
</ul>
